design: Additive nativeRecord on AreaReference and optional method/decodedRecord on text plan entries and exact excerpts; no defaults and no added GeoJSON serialized fields.

Native import preserves member/table, encoding, mapping idField and original position using sourceFeatureIndex, without renumbering accepted features around quarantine. GeoPackage reads use explicit integer-primary-key or accessible-rowid ordering and reject tables with neither.

Bounded decoders reuse existing native readers and return the selected record's decoded fields only. Retained byte length/hash, native reference/version/encoding and mapping-field source key must match; selection is by position, never by key. Non-finite/non-scalar or unsafe integer fields fail closed, never round into a claimed decoded value.

Native packet/card citations state file, member/table, record and decoded values. Excerpts start with the required decoded-field heading and reader encoding. No geometry or product-computed field enters the excerpt. Geometry/measurements remain unavailable and rights not_assessed.

Empty citation additions leave GeoJSON serialization, plan hashing and rendering unchanged. Both the captured pre-edit fixture and the same-box baseline-code comparison prove equality of plan/hash, packet, card content and controlled PDF bytes.

Runtime uses real product functions in CA0 order, nonce-labelled tmpfs PostGIS and private loopback in-memory original storage. The final run removes only its owned container; all machine container/volume/network names match before/after.
